definitions.gloss: autumn leaf viewing; maple leaf viewing
definitions.explanation: The activity of going out to view autumn foliage, especially maple leaves.

examples.english: To go autumn leaf viewing in fall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{紅葉狩|もみじが}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: I enjoyed autumn leaf viewing with friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{紅葉狩|もみじが}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.english: We went out with the family for autumn leaf viewing and enjoyed the mountain scenery colored in red and yellow.

notes:
{紅葉狩|もみじが}り is a traditional autumn activity — going to parks, mountains, or temples to enjoy the colorful fall foliage. It is the autumn counterpart of ⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧ (cherry blossom viewing) in spring.

WORD ORIGIN:
⟦{紅葉|もみじ}→紅葉：05387_momiji⟧ (autumn leaves) + ⟦{狩|か}り→狩り：02689_kari⟧ (hunting). ⟦{狩|か}り→狩り：02689_kari⟧ originally meant "hunting" but evolved to mean "going out to enjoy" nature. The same pattern appears in ⟦いちご→いちご：01028_ichigo⟧⟦{狩|が}り→狩り：02689_kari⟧ (strawberry picking).

SEASON:
Typically late October through November, with the peak moving from north to south across Japan.

FAMOUS SPOTS:
⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧, ⟦{日光|にっこう}→日光：03515_nikkou⟧, and ⟦{箱根|はこね}→箱根：30712_hakone⟧ are among the most popular {紅葉狩|もみじが}り destinations.
